meaning: even if…; no matter whether… (concessive hypothetical)

wrong_choice_explanations: 「あたかも」 is a literary simile adverb ('just as if') pairing with 〜かのようだ; it cannot introduce the 'even if' concession that 〜ても needs, unlike たとえ.
「いかにも」 means 'truly/indeed' or 'just like,' pairing with 〜らしい/〜そうだ; it does not pair with 〜ても, so it cannot express the concessive 'even if' that たとえ does.
「まるで」 is a simile adverb ('as if') that pairs with 〜のようだ/みたいだ; it cannot head a concessive 〜ても clause, so only たとえ fits here to mean 'even if.'
